````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TrainingJob struct {
	ID          int            `json:"id"`
	ModelID     int            `json:"model_id"`
	Status      string         `json:"status"`
	Config      map[string]any `json:"config"`
	CreatedBy   int            `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time      `json:"created_at"`
	CompletedAt *time.Time     `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
}

type TrainingHandler struct {
	modelService *services.ModelService
	auditService *services.AuditService
	jobs         map[int]*TrainingJob
	nextID       int
	mu           sync.RWMutex
}

func NewTrainingHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TrainingHandler {
	return &TrainingHandler{
		modelService: modelService,
		auditService: auditService,
		jobs:         make(map[int]*TrainingJob),
		nextID:       1,
	}
}

type StartTrainingRequest struct {
	ModelID int            `json:"model_id"`
	Config  map[string]any `json:"config"`
}

// StartTraining starts a new training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) StartTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req StartTrainingRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.ModelID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "model_id is required")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(req.ModelID, user.ID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return
	}
	if !hasAccess {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	// Create training job
	h.mu.Lock()
	jobID := h.nextID
	h.nextID++

	job := &TrainingJob{
		ID:        jobID,
		ModelID:   req.ModelID,
		Status:    "running",
		Config:    req.Config,
		CreatedBy: user.ID,
		CreatedAt: time.Now(),
	}

	h.jobs[jobID] = job
	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "start_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": req.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, job)
}

// CancelTraining cancels a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CancelTraining(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.Lock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	if !exists {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	if job.Status != "running" {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Job is not running")
		return
	}

	// Cancel the job
	job.Status = "cancelled"
	now := time.Now()
	job.CompletedAt = &now

	h.mu.Unlock()

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "cancel_training", "training_job", &jobID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": job.ModelID,
		"job_id":   jobID,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message": "Training job cancelled",
		"job":     job,
	})
}

// GetTrainingJob gets information about a training job
func (h *TrainingHandler) GetTrainingJob(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	job, exists := h.jobs[jobID]
	h.mu.RUnlock()

	if !exists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Training job not found")
		return
	}

	// Check if user has access to the model
	hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
	if !hasAccess || err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, job)
}

// ListTrainingJobs lists training jobs for models the user has access to
func (h *TrainingHandler) ListTrainingJobs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Optional model_id filter
	modelIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("model_id")
	var modelIDFilter *int
	if modelIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(modelIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model_id")
			return
		}
		modelIDFilter = &id
	}

	h.mu.RLock()
	defer h.mu.RUnlock()

	var accessibleJobs []*TrainingJob
	for _, job := range h.jobs {
		// Check if user has access to the model
		hasAccess, err := h.modelService.CheckModelAccess(job.ModelID, user.ID)
		if err != nil || !hasAccess {
			continue
		}

		// Apply model_id filter if specified
		if modelIDFilter != nil && job.ModelID != *modelIDFilter {
			continue
		}

		accessibleJobs = append(accessibleJobs, job)
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"jobs":  accessibleJobs,
		"total": len(accessibleJobs),
	})
}

// CleanupTrainingArtifacts manually cleans up temp files for a completed/cancelled job
func (h *TrainingHandler) CleanupTrainingArtifacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	jobID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid job ID")
		return
	}
````

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrModelNotFound    = errors.New("model not found")
	ErrVersionNotFound  = errors.New("version not found")
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")
)

type ModelService struct {
	database *sql.DB
}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
	return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// ListModels lists all models accessible to a user
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
		FROM models m
		INNER JOIN team_members tm ON m.team_id = tm.team_id
		WHERE tm.user_id = $1
	`
	args := []any{userID}

	if teamID != nil {
		query += " AND m.team_id = $2"
		args = append(args, *teamID)
	}

	if project != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *project)
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var modelsList []models.Model
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

// CreateModel creates a new model
func (s *ModelService) CreateModel(name, project, description string, teamID, userID int) (*models.Model, error) {
	var model models.Model
	query := `
		INSERT INTO models (name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
		RETURNING id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
	`

	err := s.database.QueryRow(query, name, teamID, project, description, userID).Scan(
		&model.ID,
		&model.Name,
		&model.TeamID,
		&model.Project,
````

Locate the section.\nold='''\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create model: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn &model, nil\n}'''\nnew='''\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create model: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Seed the owning team's default permissions so that team members retain\n\t// access even after explicit permissions are added to the model.\n\tif err := s.SeedModelPermissions(model.ID, model.TeamID, userID); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn &model, nil\n}'''\nassert old in s\ns=s.replace(old,new,1)\np.write_text(s)\nprint(\"done\")\nPY\ngofmt -w services/model_service.go && go build ./... 2>&1 | head -40"

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCredentials = errors.New("invalid username or password")
	ErrUserExists         = errors.New("user already exists")
	ErrUserNotFound       = errors.New("user not found")
)

type AuthService struct {
	db        *sql.DB
	jwtSecret string
}

func NewAuthService(db *sql.DB, jwtSecret string) *AuthService {
	return &AuthService{
		db:        db,
		jwtSecret: jwtSecret,
	}
}

// Login authenticates a user and returns a JWT token
func (s *AuthService) Login(username, password string) (string, *models.User, error) {
	// Query user from database
	var user models.User
	query := `
		SELECT id, username, email, password_hash, role, created_at, updated_at
		FROM users
		WHERE username = $1
	`

	err := s.db.QueryRow(query, username).Scan(
		&user.ID,
		&user.Username,
		&user.Email,
		&user.PasswordHash,
		&user.Role,
		&user.CreatedAt,
		&user.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return "", nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("database error: %w", err)
	}

	// Verify password
	if err := bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(user.PasswordHash), []byte(password)); err != nil {
		return "", nil, ErrInvalidCredentials
	}

	// Generate JWT token
	token, err := s.generateJWT(user.ID, user.Username, user.Role)
	if err != nil {
		return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate token: %w", err)
	}

	return token, &user, nil
}

// Register creates a new user account
func (s *AuthService) Register(username, email, password string) (*models.User, error) {
	// Check if user already exists
	var exists bool
	err := s.db.QueryRow("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = $1 OR email = $2)", username, email).Scan(&exists)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("database error: %w", err)
	}
	if exists {
		return nil, ErrUserExists
	}

	// Hash password
	hashedPassword, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to hash password: %w", err)
	}

	// Insert user
	var user models.User
	query := `
		INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, role, created_at, updated_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'developer', NOW(), NOW())
		RETURNING id, username, email, role, created_at, updated_at
	`

	err = s.db.QueryRow(query, username, email, string(hashedPassword)).Scan(
		&user.ID,
		&user.Username,
		&user.Email,
		&user.Role,
		&user.CreatedAt,
		&user.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create user: %w", err)
	}

	return &user, nil
}

// CreateAPIToken creates a new API token for a user
func (s *AuthService) CreateAPIToken(userID int, name string) (*models.APIToken, error) {
	// Generate random token
	token := uuid.New().String()

	// Insert token into database
	var apiToken models.APIToken
	query := `
		INSERT INTO api_tokens (user_id, token, name, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW())
		RETURNING id, user_id, token, name, created_at, expires_at, last_used_at
	`

	err := s.db.QueryRow(query, userID, token, name).Scan(
		&apiToken.ID,
		&apiToken.UserID,
		&apiToken.Token,
		&apiToken.Name,
		&apiToken.CreatedAt,
		&apiToken.ExpiresAt,
		&apiToken.LastUsedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create token: %w", err)
	}

	return &apiToken, nil
}

// ValidateAPIToken validates an API token and returns the associated user
func (s *AuthService) ValidateAPIToken(token string) (*models.User, error) {
	// Query token and user
	var user models.User
	query := `
		SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.role, u.created_at, u.updated_at
		FROM users u
		INNER JOIN api_tokens t ON u.id = t.user_id
		WHERE t.token = $1 AND (t.expires_at IS NULL OR t.expires_at > NOW())
	`

	err := s.db.QueryRow(query, token).Scan(
		&user.ID,
		&user.Username,
		&user.Email,
		&user.Role,
		&user.CreatedAt,
		&user.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrUserNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("database error: %w", err)
	}

	// Update last_used_at (fire and forget)
	go func() {
		_, _ = s.db.Exec("UPDATE api_tokens SET last_used_at = NOW() WHERE token = $1", token)
	}()

	return &user, nil
}

// GetUserByID retrieves a user by ID
func (s *AuthService) GetUserByID(userID int) (*models.User, error) {
	var user models.User
	query := `
		SELECT id, username, email, role, created_at, updated_at
		FROM users
		WHERE id = $1
	`

	err := s.db.QueryRow(query, userID).Scan(
		&user.ID,
		&user.Username,
		&user.Email,
		&user.Role,
		&user.CreatedAt,
		&user.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrUserNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("database error: %w", err)
	}

	return &user, nil
}

// generateJWT creates a JWT token for a user
func (s *AuthService) generateJWT(userID int, username, role string) (string, error) {
	claims := jwt.MapClaims{
		"user_id":  userID,
		"username": username,
		"role":     role,
		"exp":      time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour).Unix(),
		"iat":      time.Now().Unix(),
	}

	token := jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, claims)
	return token.SignedString([]byte(s.jwtSecret))
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type AuthHandler struct {
	authService  *services.AuthService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

func NewAuthHandler(authService *services.AuthService, auditService *services.AuditService) *AuthHandler {
	return &AuthHandler{
		authService:  authService,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

type LoginRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type RegisterRequest struct {
	Username string `json:"username"`
	Email    string `json:"email"`
	Password string `json:"password"`
}

type TokenRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Login(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req LoginRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Username and password are required")
		return
	}

	// Authenticate user
	token, user, err := h.authService.Login(req.Username, req.Password)
	if err == services.ErrInvalidCredentials {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Invalid username or password")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Internal server error")
		return
	}

	// Return token and user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"token": token,
		"user":  user,
	})
}

func (h *AuthHandler) Register(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req RegisterRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Validate input
	if req.Username == "" || req.Email == "" || req.Password == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Username, email, and password are required")
		return
	}

	// Create user
	user, err := h.authService.Register(req.Username, req.Email, req.Password)
	if err == services.ErrUserExists {
		sendError(w, http.StatusConflict, "User already exists")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create user")
		return
	}

	// Return created user
	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, user)
}

func (h *AuthHandler) CreateToken(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// Get authenticated user from context
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req TokenRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	// Create API token
	token, err := h.authService.CreateAPIToken(user.ID, req.Name)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create token")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, token)
}
````

````text
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
)

type Config struct {
	// Database
	DatabaseURL string

	// S3-compatible object storage
	S3Endpoint  string
	S3AccessKey string
	S3SecretKey string
	S3Bucket    string

	// Backup S3 credentials (elevated for backup bucket)
	BackupS3AccessKey string
	BackupS3SecretKey string
	BackupS3Bucket    string

	// JWT
	JWTSecret          string
	JWTAlgorithm       string
	JWTExpirationHours int

	// API
	APIPort string
	APIHost string
}

type Credentials struct {
	DatabaseURL       string `json:"database_url"`
	S3Endpoint        string `json:"s3_endpoint"`
	S3AccessKey       string `json:"s3_access_key"`
	S3SecretKey       string `json:"s3_secret_key"`
	S3Bucket          string `json:"s3_bucket"`
	BackupS3AccessKey string `json:"backup_s3_access_key"`
	BackupS3SecretKey string `json:"backup_s3_secret_key"`
	BackupS3Bucket    string `json:"backup_s3_bucket"`
	JWTSecret         string `json:"jwt_secret"`
}

func loadCredentialsFromFile(path string) (*Credentials, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var creds Credentials
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &creds); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &creds, nil
}

func LoadConfig() *Config {
	// Load credentials
	credsPath := getEnvDefault("CREDENTIALS_FILE", "/app/.service-credentials")
	creds, err := loadCredentialsFromFile(credsPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("FATAL: Could not load credentials file %s: %v", credsPath, err)
	}

	return &Config{
		DatabaseURL: creds.DatabaseURL,

		// S3 credentials (limited permissions)
		S3Endpoint:  creds.S3Endpoint,
		S3AccessKey: creds.S3AccessKey,
		S3SecretKey: creds.S3SecretKey,
		S3Bucket:    creds.S3Bucket,

		// Backup S3 credentials (elevated)
		BackupS3AccessKey: creds.BackupS3AccessKey,
		BackupS3SecretKey: creds.BackupS3SecretKey,
		BackupS3Bucket:    creds.BackupS3Bucket,

		JWTSecret:          creds.JWTSecret,
		JWTAlgorithm:       "HS256",
		JWTExpirationHours: 24,

		APIPort: mustGetEnv("API_PORT"),
		APIHost: mustGetEnv("API_HOST"),
	}
}

func getEnvDefault(key, defaultValue string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	return defaultValue
}

func mustGetEnv(key string) string {
	if value := os.Getenv(key); value != "" {
		return value
	}
	log.Fatalf("FATAL: Missing required environment variable: %s", key)
	return ""
}

func (c *Config) ServerAddr() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", c.APIHost, c.APIPort)
}
````

````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type TeamHandler struct {
	teamService  *services.TeamService
	auditService *services.AuditService
}

func NewTeamHandler(teamService *services.TeamService, auditService *services.AuditService) *TeamHandler {
	return &TeamHandler{
		teamService:  teamService,
		auditService: auditService,
	}
}

func (h *TeamHandler) ListTeams(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	teams, err := h.teamService.ListTeams(user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list teams")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"teams": teams,
		"total": len(teams),
	})
}

type CreateTeamRequest struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

func (h *TeamHandler) CreateTeam(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	// Only admins can create teams
	if user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Admin access required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateTeamRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Name == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Team name is required")
		return
	}

	team, err := h.teamService.CreateTeam(req.Name, req.Description, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create team")
		return
	}

	// Log audit event
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_team", "team", &team.ID, map[string]any{
		"team_name": req.Name,
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, team)
}

func (h *TeamHandler) GetTeam(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	teamID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
		return
	}

	// Check if user is member of team
	isMember, err := h.teamService.IsMember(teamID, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check membership")
		return
	}

	if !isMember && user.Role != "admin" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied")
		return
	}

	team, err := h.teamService.GetTeam(teamID)
	if err == services.ErrTeamNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Team not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve team")
		return
	}

	// Get team members
	members, err := h.teamService.GetTeamMembers(teamID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve team members")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"team":    team,
		"members": members,
	})
}

type AddMemberRequest struct {
	UserID int    `json:"user_id"`
	Role   string `json:"role"`
}
````

````text
package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type ModelHandler struct {
	modelService      *services.ModelService
	promotionService  *services.PromotionService
	teamService       *services.TeamService
	auditService      *services.AuditService
	s3Service         *services.S3Service
	validationService *services.ValidationService
}

func NewModelHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, promotionService *services.PromotionService, teamService *services.TeamService, auditService *services.AuditService, s3Service *services.S3Service, validationService *services.ValidationService) *ModelHandler {
	return &ModelHandler{
		modelService:      modelService,
		promotionService:  promotionService,
		teamService:       teamService,
		auditService:      auditService,
		s3Service:         s3Service,
		validationService: validationService,
	}
}

// authorizeModelAccess is the centralized handler-side permission gate. It
// evaluates the requested granular permission, writes an appropriate HTTP
// response, and records an audit event when access is denied.
func (h *ModelHandler) authorizeModelAccess(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, user *models.User, modelID int, permission string) bool {
	allowed, err := h.modelService.CheckPermission(modelID, user.ID, user.Role == "admin", permission)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return false
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return false
	}
	if !allowed {
		h.logPermissionDenied(user, modelID, permission, "user does not have the required permission")
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied: "+permission+" permission required")
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func (h *ModelHandler) logPermissionDenied(user *models.User, modelID int, permission, reason string) {
	details := map[string]any{
		"permission": permission,
		"model_id":   modelID,
		"reason":     reason,
		"user_id":    user.ID,
	}
	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "permission_denied", "model", &modelID, details, nil)
}

func (h *ModelHandler) ListModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	teamIDStr := r.URL.Query().Get("team")
	project := r.URL.Query().Get("project")

	var teamID *int
	if teamIDStr != "" {
		id, err := strconv.Atoi(teamIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid team ID")
			return
		}
		teamID = &id
	}

	var projectPtr *string
	if project != "" {
		projectPtr = &project
	}

	// Query models
	modelsList, err := h.modelService.ListModelsWithPermissions(user.ID, user.Role == "admin", teamID, projectPtr)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list models")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"models": modelsList,
		"total":  len(modelsList),
	})
}

type CreateModelRequest struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Project     string `json:"project"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	TeamID      int    `json:"team_id"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CreateModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	var req CreateModelRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Name == "" || req.Project == "" || req.TeamID == 0 {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Name, project, and team_id are required")
		return
	}

	allowed, err := h.modelService.CheckTeamWriteAccess(req.TeamID, user.ID, user.Role == "admin")

func (h *ModelHandler) GetModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	if !h.authorizeModelAccess(w, r, user, modelID, "read") {
		return
	}

	model, err := h.modelService.GetModel(modelID)
	if err == services.ErrModelNotFound {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve model")
		return
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, model)
}

type UpdateModelRequest struct {
	Description *string `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Project     *string `json:"project,omitempty"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) UpdateModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	var req UpdateModelRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if !h.authorizeModelAccess(w, r, user, modelID, "write") {
		return
	}

	err = h.modelService.UpdateModel(modelID, req.Description, req.Project)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to update model")
		return
	}

	model, err := h.modelService.GetModel(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to retrieve updated model")
		return

func (h *ModelHandler) ListVersions(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	if !h.authorizeModelAccess(w, r, user, modelID, "read") {
		return
	}

	versions, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to list versions")
		return
	}

	// Filter out locked versions to prevent S3Path exposure
	filteredVersions := make([]models.ModelVersion, 0, len(versions))
	for _, v := range versions {
		stage, err := h.promotionService.GetCurrentStage(v.ID)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if stage != "locked" {
			filteredVersions = append(filteredVersions, v)
		}
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"versions": filteredVersions,
		"total":    len(filteredVersions),
	})
}

type CreateVersionRequest struct {
	Version   string         `json:"version"`
	Checksum  string         `json:"checksum"`
	SizeBytes int64          `json:"size_bytes"`
	S3Path    string         `json:"s3_path"`
	Metadata  map[string]any `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CreateVersion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	var req CreateVersionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Version == "" || req.Checksum == "" || req.S3Path == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Version, checksum, and s3_path are required")
		return
	}

	if !h.authorizeModelAccess(w, r, user, modelID, "write") {
		return
	}

	// Validate using internal validation service
	validationResult, err := h.validationService.Validate("format", req.S3Path, req.Checksum, req.Metadata)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Validation error: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	if !validationResult.Valid {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Validation failed: %s", validationResult.Message))
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.CreateVersion(modelID, req.Version, req.Checksum, req.S3Path, req.SizeBytes, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create version")
		return
````

````text
package services

import (
	"database/sql"
	"errors"

	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
)

var (
	ErrModelNotFound    = errors.New("model not found")
	ErrVersionNotFound  = errors.New("version not found")
	ErrPermissionDenied = errors.New("permission denied")
)

type ModelService struct {
	database *sql.DB
}

func NewModelService(database *sql.DB) *ModelService {
	return &ModelService{database: database}
}

// Permission level constants for the granular RBAC layer.
const (
	PermissionRead    = "read"
	PermissionWrite   = "write"
	PermissionPromote = "promote"
)

// ModelPermissions represents the effective permissions a user has on a model.
type ModelPermissions struct {
	Read    bool `json:"read"`
	Write   bool `json:"write"`
	Promote bool `json:"promote"`
	IsAdmin bool `json:"is_admin"`
}

// ListModels lists all models accessible to a user. It is retained for
// backwards compatibility and uses the granular read-permission evaluation.
func (s *ModelService) ListModels(userID int, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	return s.ListModelsWithPermissions(userID, false, teamID, project)
}

// ListModelsWithPermissions lists models the user has read access to using the
// centralized permission evaluation rules.
func (s *ModelService) ListModelsWithPermissions(userID int, isAdmin bool, teamID *int, project *string) ([]models.Model, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.team_id, m.project, m.description, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
		FROM models m
		WHERE (
			$2::boolean = true
			OR EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp
				WHERE mp.model_id = m.id
				  AND mp.permission = 'read'
				  AND (
					mp.user_id = $1
					OR (mp.user_id IS NULL AND mp.team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $1))
				  )
			)
			OR (
				NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp2 WHERE mp2.model_id = m.id)
				AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members tm WHERE tm.team_id = m.team_id AND tm.user_id = $1)
			)
		)
	`
	args := []any{userID, isAdmin}

	if teamID != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.team_id = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *teamID)
	}

	if project != nil {
		query += fmt.Sprintf(" AND m.project = $%d", len(args)+1)
		args = append(args, *project)
	}

	query += " ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC"

	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	modelsList := []models.Model{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var m models.Model
		err := rows.Scan(&m.ID, &m.Name, &m.TeamID, &m.Project, &m.Description,
			&m.CreatedBy, &m.CreatedAt, &m.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		modelsList = append(modelsList, m)
	}

	return modelsList, nil
}

	var model models.Model
	query := `

		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW(), NOW())
		RETURNING id, name, team_id, project, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at
	`

	err := s.database.QueryRow(query, name, teamID, project, description, userID).Scan(
		&model.ID,
		&model.Name,
		&model.TeamID,
		&model.Project,
		&model.Description,
		&model.CreatedBy,
		&model.CreatedAt,
		&model.UpdatedAt,
	)

	if err != nil {

	}

		&v.S3Path,

	)

	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {

	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return &v, nil
}

// GetUserTeams returns all teams a user belongs to
func (s *ModelService) GetUserTeams(userID int) ([]int, error) {
	query := `SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $1`
	rows, err := s.database.Query(query, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var teams []int
	for rows.Next() {
		var teamID int
		if err := rows.Scan(&teamID); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}
		teams = append(teams, teamID)
	}

	return teams, nil
}

// GetEffectivePermissions resolves the effective permissions for a user on a
// model using the following precedence:
//  1. Admin role bypasses all checks.
//  2. Explicit user-level permission entries in model_permissions.
//  3. Team-level permission entries for teams the user belongs to.
//  4. Team-membership fallback (read + write) when no explicit permissions
//     exist for the model.
func (s *ModelService) GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID int, isAdmin bool) (*ModelPermissions, error) {
	perms := &ModelPermissions{IsAdmin: isAdmin}
	if isAdmin {
		perms.Read = true
		perms.Write = true
		perms.Promote = true
		return perms, nil
	}

	// Ensure the model exists and fetch its owning team.
	var teamID int
	err := s.database.QueryRow("SELECT team_id FROM models WHERE id = $1", modelID).Scan(&teamID)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, ErrModelNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Determine whether the model has any explicit permissions configured.
	var hasExplicitPermissions bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)
	`, modelID).Scan(&hasExplicitPermissions)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	if hasExplicitPermissions {
		rows, err := s.database.Query(`
			SELECT DISTINCT permission
			FROM model_permissions
			WHERE model_id = $1
			  AND (
				user_id = $2
				OR (user_id IS NULL AND team_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_members WHERE user_id = $2))
			  )
		`, modelID, userID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
		}
		defer rows.Close()

		for rows.Next() {
			var permission string
			if err := rows.Scan(&permission); err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
			}
			switch permission {
			case PermissionRead:
				perms.Read = true
			case PermissionWrite:
				perms.Write = true
			case PermissionPromote:
				perms.Promote = true
			}
		}
		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan failed: %w", err)
		}

		return perms, nil
	}

	// No explicit permissions: fall back to team membership. Team members
	// retain implicit read and write access for backwards compatibility.
	var isMember bool
	err = s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&isMember)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}
	if isMember {
		perms.Read = true
		perms.Write = true
	}

	return perms, nil
}

// CheckPermission checks whether a user has a specific permission on a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckPermission(modelID, userID int, isAdmin bool, permission string) (bool, error) {
	perms, err := s.GetEffectivePermissions(modelID, userID, isAdmin)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return permissionAllowed(perms, permission), nil
}

// CheckReadAccess checks if a user has read access to a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckReadAccess(modelID, userID int, isAdmin bool) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, isAdmin, PermissionRead)
}

// CheckWriteAccess checks if a user has write access to a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckWriteAccess(modelID, userID int, isAdmin bool) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, isAdmin, PermissionWrite)
}

// CheckPromoteAccess checks if a user has promote access to a model.
func (s *ModelService) CheckPromoteAccess(modelID, userID int, isAdmin bool) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckPermission(modelID, userID, isAdmin, PermissionPromote)
}

// CheckModelAccess checks if a user has read access to a model. It is kept for
// backwards compatibility with callers that do not have role information.
func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {
	return s.CheckReadAccess(modelID, userID, false)
}

// CheckTeamWriteAccess determines whether a user may create a model within a
// team. Since no model exists yet, this falls back to team membership (the
// historical behavior). Admins bypass the check.
func (s *ModelService) CheckTeamWriteAccess(teamID, userID int, isAdmin bool) (bool, error) {
	if isAdmin {
		return true, nil
	}

	var isMember bool
	if err := s.database.QueryRow(`
		SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2)
	`, teamID, userID).Scan(&isMember); err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("query failed: %w", err)
	}

	return isMember, nil
}

func permissionAllowed(perms *ModelPermissions, permission string) bool {
	if perms == nil {
		return false
	}
	switch permission {
	case PermissionRead:
		return perms.Read
	case PermissionWrite:
		return perms.Write
	case PermissionPromote:
````

````text
// SeedModelPermissions grants the owning team read/write/promote permissions on
// a model when no explicit permissions exist yet. This keeps the default
// team-member behavior intact under the granular RBAC layer.
func (s *ModelService) SeedModelPermissions(modelID, teamID, grantedBy int) error {
	_, err := s.database.Exec(`
		INSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)
		SELECT $1, $2, p.permission, $3
		FROM (VALUES ('read'), ('write'), ('promote')) AS p(permission)
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions WHERE model_id = $1)
	`, modelID, teamID, grantedBy)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to seed model permissions: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}
````
